title: GPT-5.1
before: GPT-5's router applied a fixed reasoning policy.
problem: Reasoning effort should track problem difficulty more finely than a router decides.
breakthrough: Adaptive reasoning effort and a coding-specialised Codex-Max variant.
why: Part of the shift to rapid point releases as the competitive cadence.
next: GPT-5.2 a month later, then the 2026 series.
